name: 84005 · Eagle Mtn, UT
findings: ZIP 84005 (Eagle Mtn) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84005 (Eagle Mtn) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84005 (Eagle Mtn) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 21% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
